## 中文

### 新增与更新

- 新增 FTP Server（drakmor）1.16-ng-stable 和 PS5 Web File Manager v1.9 的下载、校验与 ELF 发送入口。
- WebKit Autoloader 更新至 v0.5.1；旧版缓存需要重新下载。
- Kstuff 组件切换为 1.13-fpkg-dr-test5，保留原组件 ID。支持下载固定 GBAtemp 7z 附件，分别校验压缩包和 ELF 的大小及 SHA-256。
- 添加随应用打包的 7zip 解压工具，仅提取指定文件，并限制输出大小、支持超时和取消；下载或校验失败保留已有缓存。
- 同步中英文界面及使用说明。

### 下载与已知限制

- Windows x64 提供安装版和便携版；macOS Intel、Apple Silicon 分别提供 DMG 和 ZIP。
- 所有应用包未签名，macOS 未公证。新增组件及 PS5 13.40/13.60 的相关兼容性尚未完成实机验证；ELF 发送完成不代表已成功执行。
- Kstuff test5 校验值来自本地下载核验，尚未与作者公布值核对。旧 Lite 缓存需重新下载；GBAtemp 下载直连，不使用 GitHub 镜像。
- FTP 默认端口为 2121；Web File Manager 默认端口为 8888，实际以主机启动通知为准。Web File Manager 的解压 helper 不由本应用下载或安装。
- 第三方组件仅在用户主动操作后下载，不随安装包附带。本项目用于技术交流及合法授权测试，请遵循第三方许可和 README 中的使用边界。

## English

### Changes

- Add download, verification, and ELF transfer entries for FTP Server (drakmor) 1.16-ng-stable and PS5 Web File Manager v1.9.
- Update WebKit Autoloader to v0.5.1; cached older versions must be downloaded again.
- Switch the Kstuff component to 1.13-fpkg-dr-test5 while retaining its component ID. Download the pinned GBAtemp 7z attachment and verify both the archive and extracted ELF by size and SHA-256.
- Bundle the 7zip extraction tool. Extract only the selected member with output limits, timeout, and cancellation support; preserve existing cache on download or verification failure.
- Update the Chinese and English UI and documentation.

### Downloads and limitations

- Windows x64 includes installer and portable packages; macOS Intel and Apple Silicon each include DMG and ZIP packages.
- All app builds are unsigned; macOS builds are not notarized. New components and related PS5 13.40/13.60 compatibility still require hardware verification. A completed ELF transfer does not confirm successful execution.
- Kstuff test5 hashes were checked against a local download and have not been compared with author-published hashes. Download again to replace the old Lite cache. GBAtemp downloads use direct connections, not the GitHub mirror.
- FTP defaults to port 2121. Web File Manager defaults to 8888; follow the console's startup notification for the actual port. This app does not download or install its extraction helper.
- Third-party components are downloaded only on user action and are not bundled in app packages. This project is for technical exchange and authorized testing; follow third-party licenses and the usage boundaries in the README.
